name: Salesforce Admin
tools: Trailhead Playgrounds and special Developer Edition orgs

beginner.summary: For new administrators, business analysts and power users taking over a Salesforce org, working hands-on in a Developer Edition org or Trailhead Playground. Covers the Platform Administrator exam scope: company settings, users and licences, objects, fields and relationships, formulas and validation, Lightning apps and pages, profiles, permission sets and sharing, Sales Cloud and Service Cloud configuration, activities and mobile, data tools, reports and dashboards, Flow and approvals, sandboxes and change sets, AgentExchange packages and the Agentforce and Einstein features an admin turns on.
prerequisites: Understands everyday sales and customer service work: leads, deals, customers and support requests
Comfortable with web applications, spreadsheets and CSV files
A free Developer Edition org and a Trailhead account with a Trailhead Playground
outcomes: Configure company settings, users, licences, objects, fields, relationships and Lightning pages
Control access with profiles, permission sets, roles, org-wide defaults and sharing rules
Configure Sales Cloud and Service Cloud processes, load clean data and build reports and dashboards
Automate work with Flow and approvals, move changes with change sets, turn on Agentforce features and sit the Platform Administrator exam

intermediate.summary: For working administrators who already configure orgs and are preparing for Platform Administrator II and Platform App Builder. Covers delegated administration and complex sharing, data model and page design choices, Sales Territories and forecasting, bulk-safe Flow design, debugging and orchestration, declarative integration, Omni-Channel and entitlements, Experience Cloud, Revenue Cloud, data governance, advanced reporting, Lifecycle Center, org monitoring and Agentforce agent configuration.
prerequisites: Holds the Platform Administrator certification or has a year of hands-on admin work
Builds objects, page layouts, reports, record-triggered flows and sharing rules without help
A Developer Edition org plus the Trailhead special orgs for Revenue Cloud and Lifecycle Center
outcomes: Design complex access with delegated administration, permission set groups, teams, territories and restriction rules
Build, debug and orchestrate multi-step flows and connect external systems without code
Configure Omni-Channel, entitlements, Experience Cloud sites and Revenue Cloud quoting
Govern data, monitor the org, promote changes with Lifecycle Center and configure Agentforce agents
